single_fixed_architecture.levels: Original nodes N0 -> connected fine aggregates A0(target2048,safety4096) -> coarse aggregates A1(target128,safety512)

single_fixed_architecture.modules: One embedding Linear47to32 and four independent Linear64to32 modules ordered coarse0,coarse1,fine0,fine1. No learned attention, new head, extra token branch, radius or width alternatives.
single_fixed_architecture.normalization: Every LN32 has elementwise_affine=false and eps=1e-5; all six normalization uses have zero trainable parameters. FP32 context tensors follow the common high/TF32 policy; native decoder arithmetic remains unchanged.
single_fixed_architecture.neighbor_operator: A1_neighbors=diag(W1*1)^-1@W1 and A2_neighbors=diag(W2*1)^-1@W2, using positive real cut-edge multiplicities; degree-zero rows are identity. These are message operators, distinct from the common Jacobi prolongation J.
single_fixed_architecture.sole_pair_difference: message_mode=self_only|neighbors selects only A1/A2. All inputs, restrictions, prolongations, module order/weights, constants, nonlinearities and budgets are identical. Both execute all four Linear64to32 modules, even in self-only.
single_fixed_architecture.hierarchy_receptive_limit: Two updates per quotient level plus the shared fixed restrictions/prolongations give a bounded hierarchy-mediated receptive field. They do not guarantee a global mesh solve or propagation across the graph diameter. The unchanged PointNet global32 remains a global summary in both modes.
single_fixed_architecture.existing_spatial_mixing: Self-only still contains connected aggregate pooling, actual coarse geometry and positive P01/P12 neighbor smoothing. It is not a no-topology or no-neighbor-information control; the pair isolates learned neighbor-message aggregation conditional on those common operations.

cost_estimates_not_measurements.prolongation_query: Cost scales with selected P01 nnz times32. The input-plan average<=64 nnz/row does not bound every selected row or the incidence-biased sampled-row average. At observed mean64, weighted query mixing is about0.21GFLOPs, not a promised runtime.
cost_estimates_not_measurements.bounded_working_memory: Prefer chunked sparse row multiplication/gather-scatter. Do not materialize all nnz times32 features at once:51200*64*32 FP32 would be~400MiB. No dense N0xA0 matrix or automatic sparse clipping.
